business_location_basis: User answered UK to the registration and dispatch question; legal entity details remain to be verified in the ad account.
target_scope: Existing 31 continental European storefront markets, UK, UAE and Saudi Arabia; broader Europe requires an explicit country list.
recommendation: Propose one focused UK Search test after eligibility and tracking review, with combined average daily budgets at or below US$5 equivalent before billing adjustments, to respect the confirmed US$10 daily maximum under the native 2x billed-media limit.
search_language_policy: As of September 2026, Search matches languages from creatives and landing pages; do not use legacy campaign language targeting for new Search campaigns.
presence_targeting: Propose Presence only; the current connector geo-targeting action does not expose this advanced option, so verify through Google Ads UI/API before activation.
